extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
A special release for Hasbro’s PulseCon 2021, the Purrfection Secret Lair contains four cards — Chain Lightning, Generous Gift, Heirloom Blade, and Kodama’s Reach. Each card features new, cat-themed artwork, illustrated by Ayako Ishiguro, a Japanese artist best known for her “monster cat” designs and popular picture book, Bakeneko Zorozoro.

CONTENTS:
1x Alt-Art Chain Lightning
1x Alt-Art Generous Gift
1x Alt-Art Heirloom Blade
1x Alt-Art Kodama's Reach
